description: U. Y. Fincorp Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides financial and related services in India. The company offers fund based services, including infrastructure funding, industrial assets funding, loan against shares, inter corporate deposits, equity participation, retail finance, real estate funding, loan against properties, bridge finance, and bill discounting. It also provides loan syndication and project counseling services. In addition, the company offers corporate loans, micro-enterprise loans, personal loans, and loans against property. Further, it invests in securities and trades in securities; and provides Equipment Financing under the GrowU.money brand. It serves corporates, entrepreneurs, micro-enterprises, and individual borrowers. The company was formerly known as Golden Goenka Fincorp Limited and changed its name to U. Y. Fincorp Limited in December 2018. U. Y. Fincorp Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India.
